title: Martian scout ship finds a volatile primordial Earth
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Martian scout ship finds a volatile primordial Earth, about remote prehistory (millions of years BC) at Mars / primordial Earth, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a group of them were sent out in a craft to go scout out a new world that they could possibly develop as a habitation for themselves

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani relays a story he credits to a man named Joe McMoneagle: in the far distant past, millions of years ago, beings living on Mars sent a group out in a craft to scout a new world they might settle. According to the story, they found the young Earth wild and unstable. If true, it would tie the story of Earth to visitors from Mars long before humans.
